study_title: Property-free material similarity: revised Phase 1 process-data audit
property_policy: No property or target column is retained or used.
expert_policy: No expert labels or post-hoc expert scoring.

missingness_policy.dataset_specific_rule: Blank and null HTEM process cells are NOT_REPORTED unless an explicit source assertion supports another state.

template_policy.method_family_status: empirical control-profile family, not a synthesis-method label

phase2_fixed_design.cluster_algorithm: average-linkage agglomerative clustering on precomputed dissimilarities
phase2_fixed_design.final_judgment: Exploratory success requires at least one scientifically interpretable and reproducible cluster or material-pair pattern under one or more prespecified profiles; no universal best metric is required. The profile, uncertainty bound, resolution, controls, and proxy support must all be reported, and isolated post-hoc anecdotes do not qualify.
